decision: The current BTE gate/readiness/catalog/result-contract boundary is mostly source-agnostic, cross-market component role requirements are source-binding registry policy instead of product-name constants, source adapter registrations declare their accepted table family and NT data type, and accepted-tranche metadata now materializes into a validated operator run-spec without venue branches. The accepted-object registry is generic, but only the native-trades CSV adapter is registered for durable canonical use and PMXT remains a separate one-off adapter. Adding a new source is easy only when it can reuse an existing registered adapter and NT data class; adding a new raw format or data family still requires a new adapter and proof.

generic_surfaces_proven.evidence: The guard rejects Bybit, Binance, BNBUSDC, public_archive, Korean venue names, former Kimchi/cross-market sample role literals, and other sample values in generic production Rust. PMXT/Polymarket names are allowed only in explicit one-off/proof modules and thin bins.

Concrete sources, venues, product families, market-structure fixtures, source URIs, extractors, evidence states, and table families are registry rows. Binance, OKX, Bybit, Deribit, Hyperliquid, Polymarket/PMXT, and Kalshi are data entries, not generic gate branches.

SourceProofReport acceptance validates source_binding, venue, product_family, market_structure_fixture, evidence_state, table_family, and optional required_cross_market_component_roles against SourceBindingRegistry before an object can become AcceptedDataset.

Production Rust no longer contains KIMCHI_PREMIUM_SIGNAL_FAMILY, KIMCHI_REQUIRED_CROSS_MARKET_ROLES, or the former concrete sample role names. Source-binding rows may declare required_cross_market_component_roles, focused tests prove a non-Kimchi cross-market source fails when a configured role is missing and passes when the configured role is present, and source-proof-policy-hardcode-audit.2026-06-09.json records the production-region literal scan.

Readiness uses configured source_binding, required_table_family, required_nt_data_types, allowed source-proof usage scopes, allowed current BTE statuses, and allowed Parquet catalog statuses. It blocks on missing mapping entries, missing NT data types, missing per-required-data-class evidence refs, source-proof mismatch, missing or disallowed usage scope, or disallowed status values without venue-specific branches.
Coverage counts configured source bindings and table families from TOML and ledger records; it explicitly does not infer bindings from prefixes or venue names.

Readiness joins preflight, source-proof migration, binding coverage, required table family, required NT data type, and configured supported data paths. The check is table-family/NT-data-type driven, not venue driven.

BacktestingRunManifest owns NT BacktestRunConfig, BacktestDataConfig, BacktestVenueConfig, catalog inputs, artifact_root, and result-contract provenance. It also records unsupported NT venue/query surfaces explicitly rather than silently ignoring them.

SourceAdapterDefinition now declares adapter kind, table_family, normalized_schema_version, and nt_data_type. Operator preflight rejects a source proof whose accepted table_family does not match the registered source adapter before conversion artifacts are written, and also fails closed unless an explicit runner dispatch exists for the adapter kind. The current durable dispatch supports CsvNativeTrades only.

BackfillRunSpecMaterializationSpec reads an accepted-tranche manifest and TOML run-spec template, patches accepted_object, source_proof, source_proof.acceptance_scope, converter.raw_payload, and manifest values, parses the result as operator::RunSpec, and writes a create-only/idempotent backfill-run-spec.toml. The focused test uses synthetic source values and then feeds the generated run-spec into BackfillExecutionRunBinding plus evaluate_backfill_execution_plan before payload fetch.
BackfillExecutionPlanSpec is source-agnostic and now requires max_source_rows, max_projected_row_groups, and max_wall_seconds in TOML before a ready execution plan can be emitted.

BackfillExecutionReadinessSpec is source-agnostic and requires required_source_usage_scope in TOML. It blocks source-catalog mapping readiness reports whose allowed or observed usage scope does not match the configured execution scope, whose nt_catalog_mapping_proven flag is false, or whose proof/binding/table/data-type fields do not match before payload fetch or operator execution. When source-selection readiness is required, it also rejects ready-looking reports whose explicit source-proof booleans, acceptance error, or unmet-check fields are inconsistent with proven source selection.

source_specific_surfaces_found.evidence: REGISTERED_SOURCE_ADAPTERS currently contains csv-native-trades-to-canonical-trades.v1 with kind=CsvNativeTrades, table_family=trades, and nt_data_type=TradeTick. Compatibility helpers expose the same entry as REGISTERED_TRADE_CONVERTERS, and normalize_registered_trade_converter dispatches CsvNativeTrades to normalize_csv_native_trades.
source_specific_surfaces_found.impact: A new venue whose accepted object is native trade CSV/GZIP/ZIP can reuse this path by TOML config. A new raw container, schema family, bars, L2 deltas, snapshots, or non-trade event stream cannot be added by TOML alone.

source_specific_surfaces_found.evidence: run_from_run_spec validates a registered source adapter by identity/version and table_family, then the current durable runner decodes CSV text from CsvGzip/CsvText/SingleCsvZip, writes canonical-trades.parquet, and projects TradeTicks. This is systematic for native trade CSV sources but not a general raw-source adapter runner.

The module requires SourceProofUsageScope::OneOffBackfillData and uses configured PMXT selected-source schema columns plus NT Polymarket parser/model surfaces. It rejects canonical usage and should not be treated as the durable generic L2 adapter.

Polymarket-specific proof code reuses nautilus-polymarket Gamma parser/provider surfaces for the bounded PMXT/Polymarket path. This is acceptable as source-specific proof/adaptation, not generic gate logic.

solutions.when_valid: A new source provides accepted native trade rows that can be decoded as configured CsvGzip, CsvText, or SingleCsvZip and mapped with CsvTradeMappingConfig.
changes_required: Add accepted SourceProofReport and accepted-object proof for the exact source/window.
Add TOML run-spec template with converter.identity = csv-native-trades-to-canonical-trades.v1 and configured CSV columns/side tokens.
Materialize the operator run spec from the accepted tranche before payload fetch.
Run source-catalog mapping readiness and execution readiness gates.

solutions.when_valid: A new source has a new raw container, schema family, or NT output family such as bars, L2 OrderBookDelta, fixed-depth snapshots, prediction-market metadata, or mixed OrderBookDelta plus TradeTick.
changes_required: Add one adapter module with a registered converter identity/version and supported table_family -> NT data class declaration.
Keep all runtime source values, column names, side tokens, row budgets, object limits, and event-family roles in TOML/source-proof artifacts.
The adapter must accept only an AcceptedDataset or selected-source artifact chain, not raw paths directly.
The adapter must write ConversionManifest, ConversionCheckpoint, ConversionCatalogMetadata, and result-contract provenance using the existing conversion boundary.
The adapter must project to NT-native data classes and use ParquetDataCatalog plus BacktestNode where NT provides the mechanism.
Readiness must be proven by source_binding, table_family, NT data classes, source-proof status, catalog status, and bounded cost/coverage evidence.
solutions.generic_gate_changes_required: Only add the adapter registration if the existing registry cannot describe the data family; do not add venue branches to readiness gates.

solutions.when_valid: PMXT is used only to prove one-off Polymarket L2+TradeTick mapping and current artifact behavior.
changes_required: Do not use PMXT coverage ledger as canonical-ready evidence while source_proof_status remains pending.

Do not start broad PMXT payload download, full-object hash, conversion, catalog projection, or BacktestNode until manifest/index-only coverage, cost, storage, dynamic tick-size policy, and accepted source proof are proven.

solutions.when_valid: Before claiming the source-proof layer can accept new cross-market signal families without product-name constants.
changes_required: SourceProofReport acceptance validates required component roles from the matched source-binding row.
Focused tests cover both the former Kimchi policy and a custom cross-market source-binding row.

accepted_claims: Generic BTE gate/readiness surfaces are source_binding/table_family/NT-data-type driven.
Cross-market component role requirements are source-binding registry config, not product-category constants.
Registered accepted-object converters declare the table family they can consume, and operator preflight rejects table-family mismatches before conversion artifacts.
Accepted-tranche metadata now materializes into a validated operator run-spec before payload fetch without adding venue-specific branches.
Bybit and Binance are sample/reference source rows, not generic production gate branches.
PMXT and Polymarket names are confined to explicit one-off/proof modules and test fixtures by a committed guard test.
Adding another source that matches the existing native-trade CSV adapter should require registry/source-proof/run-spec data, not generic gate code.
rejected_claims: Adding any new venue or data type is TOML-only today.
PMXT is a durable canonical Polymarket source today.
The accepted-object operator is a general raw-source adapter runner today.
Every future adapter/source policy is TOML-only today.
next_required_evidence: Extend the registered adapter contract into a durable non-trade-CSV adapter runner before adding any non-trade-CSV durable source.
Keep the source-proof policy hardcode guard in CI and extend it when new source-family policy literals are introduced.
For Polymarket/PMXT, accept durable source proof plus coverage/cost/storage/dynamic-tick-size evidence before broad backfill.
Apply the accepted-tranche materializer to bounded accepted native-trade tranches before expanding payload work.
Keep GitHub CI as the broad verification gate for any committed changes.
